skill.description: Help users set up mirrord in CI pipelines for testing against real Kubernetes environments. Use when users want to run end-to-end tests, integration tests, or automated tests in CI using mirrord to connect to staging/shared clusters.
skill.summary: Configure mirrord CI workflows to test applications against Kubernetes environments with platform-specific setup, validation, and cleanup guidance.
skill.author: metalbear-co

security_audit.summary: Of 400 supplied alerts, 399 concern documentation or intended CI operations; signature removal presents a genuine integrity risk. Four semantic findings cover certificate bypass, privileged containers, cluster-wide network changes, and unsupported isolation assurances. No evidence found of prompt injection or covert exfiltration; two omitted static matches still require manual review. Static review was capped at 400/402 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 2 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Troubleshooting removes binary signatures with sudo.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer compatible development binaries. Require explicit approval for signature changes, restrict changes to disposable copies, and avoid sudo when ownership permits.

remediation.issue: Certificate errors are addressed by trusting every certificate.
remediation.suggestion: Configure the correct certificate chain and trust roots. Restrict any temporary bypass to isolated diagnostics with explicit approval and immediate restoration.

remediation.issue: Permission failures trigger privileged container recommendations.
remediation.suggestion: Diagnose RBAC, filesystem permissions, and security policies first. Require cluster administrator approval and document narrower capabilities before enabling privileged agents.

remediation.issue: The Cilium workaround changes shared networking infrastructure.
remediation.suggestion: Require administrator approval, a tested maintenance plan, and rollback steps. Pin the chart version and test changes outside shared clusters.

remediation.issue: Isolation claims omit potential shared dependency writes.
remediation.suggestion: Qualify the isolation claim. Add explicit traffic filters, isolated test data, database branches where supported, and approval before accessing shared services.

remediation.issue: The supplied static catalog excludes two lower-priority or repeated matches.
remediation.suggestion: Provide the two omitted matches for manual adjudication before automatic publication.

content.user_title: Configure mirrord CI Tests for Kubernetes
content.value_statement: Integration tests often require access to services already running in Kubernetes. This skill guides mirrord CI setup with platform-specific workflows, configuration validation, and session cleanup.
actual_capabilities: Generate CI workflow examples for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, and Jenkins.
Configure mirrord CI session startup, application commands, and cleanup after tests.
Guide Kubernetes authentication setup using CI secrets and dedicated service accounts.
Use the bundled mirrord schema and CLI verification command to check configuration files.
Explain Enterprise CI API key setup and application log locations.
Troubleshoot linking, DNS, port mapping, multi-container targeting, and environment variable conflicts.
limitations: Requires an installed mirrord CLI, Kubernetes connectivity, and appropriate cluster permissions; the skill does not supply these resources.
Licensed Operator and CI API key requirements must be verified for your plan; the source guidance is inconsistent about eligibility.
Dynamic linking and runtime compatibility constrain which applications mirrord can intercept.
Shared service access does not guarantee isolated data or side effects; some troubleshooting suggestions weaken security controls.

use_cases.title: Add Staging Integration Tests
use_cases.description: Create a GitHub Actions workflow that starts an application with mirrord, runs integration tests, and stops sessions after failures.

use_cases.title: Standardize CI Cluster Access
use_cases.description: Adapt authentication, namespace permissions, secret references, and cleanup hooks for the CI platforms used across a team.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Failed Test Sessions
use_cases.description: Investigate missing traffic, environment conflicts, linking issues, or log locations before making changes to shared infrastructure.

prompt_templates.title: Check Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare mirrord CI for [CI platform]. Ask about my Kubernetes target, CLI version, cluster access, and licensing before suggesting changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a CI Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [CI platform] workflow for deployment [name] in namespace [namespace]. Use [application command] and [test command], secret references, approved installation, and cleanup after failures.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Failed Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this mirrord CI failure using sanitized logs: [logs]. Check target selection, runtime compatibility, environment filters, and port mapping. Ask before changing cluster settings.

prompt_templates.title: Review Shared Cluster Safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [workflow] and [mirrord configuration] for shared staging use. Assess permissions, traffic filters, dependency writes, secret exposure, and cleanup. Validate proposed configuration and require approval for security exceptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate configuration and operational boundaries

output_examples.input: Plan a GitHub Actions integration test job for our staging API.
output: Prerequisites: confirm the mirrord version, Operator entitlement, runner connectivity, and dedicated staging credentials.
Workflow: check out the application, configure authentication, start the target session, and run integration tests.
Cleanup: stop the session regardless of test success.
Safety review: confirm test data isolation and prevent untrusted changes from receiving cluster credentials.

output_examples.input: Our Next.js application behaves differently when CI connects through mirrord.
output: Check whether remote environment values conflict with the local Next.js or Nx runtime.
Review NODE_ENV and NX_NEXT_DIR without printing secret values.
Propose targeted environment exclusions and validate the resulting mirrord configuration before another test run.

output_examples.input: Certificate errors appeared after moving tests to a macOS runner.
output: Compare the runner trust store with the container certificate chain.
Configure approved trust roots instead of accepting every certificate.
Treat any temporary certificate bypass as a security exception requiring explicit approval.

best_practices: Use approved, pinned tooling and restrict cluster credentials to trusted jobs with the minimum required permissions.
Validate mirrord configuration and verify traffic and data isolation before testing against shared services.
Always stop sessions after tests and require explicit approval for privilege, certificate, or cluster networking changes.
anti_patterns: Giving untrusted pull request code access to shared cluster credentials or Enterprise API keys.
Treating mirrord connectivity as automatic isolation from shared database writes and external side effects.
Copying privileged mode, certificate bypass, or cluster networking workarounds into routine CI without review.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Which CI platforms have examples?
faq.answer: The source includes GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, and Jenkins examples.

faq.question: What must already be available?
faq.answer: The guide requires mirrord CLI 3.181.0 or later, Kubernetes access, kubeconfig, and a licensed Operator. Confirm current entitlement requirements before implementation.

faq.question: How should CI secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Use your CI secret store for Kubernetes credentials and the Enterprise CI API key. Restrict access to trusted jobs and avoid logging values.

faq.question: Does mirrord guarantee isolated tests?
faq.answer: No. Configure traffic selection and test data isolation explicitly, because application requests can still affect shared services.

faq.question: Are all troubleshooting suggestions safe defaults?
faq.answer: No. Certificate bypass, privileged containers, signature removal, and cluster networking changes require security review and explicit approval.
